description: This file provides database access functions for a notes application, including initializing the database, CRUD operations for notes, and utility functions for database connection management.

methods.name: _utc_now_iso
methods.description: Returns the current UTC time as an ISO 8601 string with 'Z' suffix.

methods.name: _default_sqlite_path
methods.description: Computes a default file path for the SQLite database within the repository.

methods.name: get_sqlite_db_path
methods.description: Retrieves the SQLite database path from environment variable or default path.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Context manager that yields a SQLite connection with foreign keys enforced.

methods.name: init_db
methods.description: Initializes the database schema if it does not exist.

methods.name: _row_to_note_dict
methods.description: Converts a SQLite row into a dictionary representing a note.

methods.name: list_notes
methods.description: Returns a list of notes, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: get_note
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its ID.

methods.name: create_note
methods.description: Creates a new note with a title and content, returning the created note.

methods.name: update_note
methods.description: Updates an existing note's title and/or content, returning the updated note.

methods.name: delete_note
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, returning True if successful.
